levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than two of the four checkpoints included a water break.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four checkpoints included a water break.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All four checkpoints are completed, and an extra checkpoint is added on a more active day.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No thirst note is recorded before drinking, or every note is identical without checking.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A distinct thirst note is recorded before drinking at each of the four checkpoints.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Thirst notes are recorded, and the learner identifies a specific pattern across the day, such as the least thirsty checkpoint.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No connection is made between drinking water and how the learner felt afterward.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner names one checkpoint where drinking changed how they felt.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner names the checkpoint, describes the specific change, and explains why that checkpoint likely showed the biggest change.

lookFors: Thirst notes use the three given labels (not thirsty, a little thirsty, very thirsty) rather than unrelated mood words.
The comparison in the independent task references actual notes written that day, not a guess made afterward.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
